text:
aria: dropped a mobile-first mock for the onboarding strip. goal: single-column, minimal chrome, persistent progress. PTAL for copy + a11y.

noah: nice! on small widths the sample cards wrap awkwardly. could we collapse them into a horizontal carousel with snap? avoids long vertical scroll.

terry: carousel is fine but ensure each item has an explicit aria-roledescription=\"slide\" and position text like \"1 of 4\" for screen readers. also add pause/play for motion.

emma: copy thought: top line currently says \"Set up your project\" which is vague. suggest \"Pick a sample project to try Redwood\" or shorter: \"Try a sample project\".

aria: agree on copy. maybe show a single sample highlighted and a small list button \"More samples\" to reduce cognitive load. keeps entry point focused.

noah: analytics ask: please add data-tag `onboarding.entry.sample_click` to card CTAs and `onboarding.entry.skip` to the skip link. we'll use to track conversion by cohort.

terry: small contrast nit: the muted helper text under the progress bar is using #888 on white; needs to be at least 4.5:1 for body copy. move to #575757.

emma: localization: we need to avoid hard-coded times like \"takes ~2 mins\" in the heading. pluggable string e.g., `onboarding.estimate_time` so translators can adjust.

aria: good catch. also voice tone: for enterprise trials, replace \"sample\" with \"starter\" to match sales copy. toggle by org type.

console-bot: Uploaded asset: https://redwood.in/figma/onboard/mobile-strip-v3 (labels: single-highlight, carousel, more-samples).

noah: interaction edge-case: if user clicks a sample but abandons on the snippet page, we should surface a toast on return \"Resume where you left off\". retention improves.

terry: keyboard focus order for the carousel must be: prev -> current -> next -> more-samples -> skip. make sure tab stops are preserved and not trapped.

emma: microcopy for skip: current text \"Skip\" feels abrupt. try \"Skip for now\" or \"I'll do this later\" — more human. A/B test both.

aria: UX decision: show progress bar only after they open a sample project. before that, show a soft pill with bullets: \"Pick one — Try it — Deploy\". less pressure.

noah: perf: lazy-load sample thumbnails with low-res placeholder plus `loading=\"lazy\"`. also compress images to webp at 20% quality for thumbnails.

terry: accessibility QA checklist I want added: 1) NVDA walkthrough of carousel, 2) VoiceOver rotor announcements for \"Open sample\" buttons, 3) keyboard-only flow from empty-dashboard -> entry strip -> sample page.

emma: design tweak: make the CTA primary color 12px taller on mobile to improve tap targets (min 44px hit area).

aria: logging action items: aria to update Figma with single-highlight + more-samples pattern; noah to add analytics tags and perf notes; terry to add a11y checklist PR comment; emma to prepare two skip CTAs for A/B. I'll sync with PM and ship a small experiment.

ops-bot: Deployed prototype review environment: https://staging.redwood.in/onboard/1815554321 (expires in 7 days).

noah: moving to implement tomorrow, will ping when PR is ready.

emma: thanks — can we include copy variants in the PR description so QA can run localized checks?

aria: will do. thanks everyone :sparkles:
